decision.summary: A multi-axis transient begins at index 478 with a large vertical (U) drop (~15 MAD), concurrent eastward (E) uplift (~10 MAD) and northward (N) dip (~3 MAD). U and N remain offset through end of allowed context (515); E shows a partial opposing trend from 482–485 but does not fully revert. No complete return observed for any axis within [440,515], so the interval is classified as uncertain. The candidate jump at index 475 is inconsistent with the observed step timing (actual step at 478) and magnitude, and is rejected.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply (~15 MAD) at index 478, sustained through 485; E rises ~10 MAD at 478 then shows partial return (downward trend) from 482–485 but not back to pre-event level; N dips ~3 MAD at 478 and remains offset. Return on U and N unobserved within allowed context; E recovery incomplete. Status: uncertain due to ambiguous/unresolved return.
